title: Fig Shares the Plum
checkpoint: Year 1 Spring 1, week 2 — School readiness — Phase 5: new ways to say and spell i, o, o, u
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations u as yoo, c as s, g as j.

pages.text: Fig finds one ripe plum on the plant.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar discovering a single ripe purple plum growing on a vine inside a glass hut full of plants.

pages.text: Ned, Olive and Nell all want a bit.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling, Olive the owl and Nell the bee gathered around Fig, all looking at the plum.

pages.text: Fig has just one plum to share.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar holding the single plum, looking at the three waiting friends.

pages.text: Fig cuts the plum into bits.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar slicing the plum into several small, equal pieces.

pages.text: Fig gets a bit for Ned.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar handing a slice of plum to Ned the duckling.

pages.text: Fig gets a bit for Olive.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar handing a slice of plum to Olive the owl.

pages.text: Fig gets a bit for Nell.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar handing a slice of plum to Nell the bee.

pages.text: Fig keeps the last bit for itself.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar holding the final small slice of plum for itself.

pages.text: Fig, Ned, Olive and Nell sit and munch the plum.
pages.illustration: Fig, Ned, Olive and Nell sitting together in the glass hut, all eating their slices of plum.

pages.text: It was good to share the plum.
pages.illustration: The four friends smiling together, plum juice on their faces, clearly happy.
